purpose: Representative, authoritative-parser-accepted formatter grammar probes; not exhaustive conformance

cases.query: SELECT id AS video_id, title FROM @yt_sql_fixture LIMIT 3
SELECT DISTINCT title FROM @yt_sql_fixture LIMIT 3
SELECT id FROM @yt_sql_fixture ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 5 OFFSET 2
SELECT title, COUNT(*) AS total FROM @yt_sql_fixture GROUP BY title HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 LIMIT 5
SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE title IS NOT NULL) AS total FROM @yt_sql_fixture LIMIT 1
SELECT CASE WHEN view_count > 5 THEN 'high' ELSE 'low' END AS tier FROM @yt_sql_fixture LIMIT 1
SELECT COALESCE(title, 'missing') AS value FROM @yt_sql_fixture LIMIT 1
SELECT (view_count + 2) * 3 AS score FROM @yt_sql_fixture LIMIT 1
WITH chosen AS (SELECT id FROM @yt_sql_fixture LIMIT 5) SELECT id FROM chosen LIMIT 2
SELECT id FROM @yt_sql_fixture UNION SELECT id FROM @yt_sql_fixture LIMIT 5
SELECT a.id FROM @yt_sql_fixture AS a INNER JOIN @yt_sql_fixture AS b ON a.id = b.id LIMIT 5
SELECT a.id FROM @yt_sql_fixture AS a LEFT JOIN @yt_sql_fixture AS b ON a.id = b.id LIMIT 5
SELECT id FROM @yt_sql_fixture WHERE (view_count > 10 AND title IS NOT NULL) OR id = 3 LIMIT 5
SELECT id FROM @yt_sql_fixture WHERE title ILIKE '%straße%' LIMIT 1
SELECT id FROM @yt_sql_fixture WHERE title DOES NOT CONTAIN 'straße' LIMIT 1
SELECT id FROM @yt_sql_fixture WHERE title MATCHES '.*' LIMIT 1
SELECT id FROM @yt_sql_fixture WHERE title IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'straße' LIMIT 1
SELECT id FROM @yt_sql_fixture WHERE view_count BETWEEN 1 AND 10 LIMIT 1
SELECT id FROM @yt_sql_fixture WHERE id IN (1, 2, 3) LIMIT 1
SELECT id FROM @yt_sql_fixture WHERE title IS NULL LIMIT 1
SELECT `title` FROM @yt_sql_fixture LIMIT 1
SELECT tags[0] AS first_tag FROM @yt_sql_fixture LIMIT 1
SELECT metadata.author AS author FROM @yt_sql_fixture LIMIT 1
